statement: Vocabulary edition typescript/1: how the How's code-fact terms appear in typescript, and which typescript APIs are effects.
why: The realisation vocabulary for the typescript language target. Decisions name none of this; a decision is realisable in typescript iff every fact term it reads is mapped here.

facts.sdlc:dependsOn: a dependency on another workspace package
facts.sdlc:inComponent: the workspace package whose sources contain the declaration
facts.sdlc:realises: the JSDoc tag @realises <What element IRI> on the declaration
facts.sdlc:usesApi: an import specifier, or a reference to a global member
facts.sdlc:handlesRoute: a route registration server.post(path, handler) whose handler is the declaration
